data.one_liner: A customizable and extensible virtual keyboard widget for Flutter desktop and touchscreen apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides an on-screen virtual keyboard with support for customizable layouts, multiple keyboard modes (alphanumeric, symbols), themes like Gboard and iOS, and dedicated text fields for handling input.
use_when: You are building a desktop or touchscreen app where a physical keyboard is unavailable or limited
You need custom keyboard layouts and themes in your Flutter application
avoid_when: You only need standard mobile system keyboards without custom on-screen rendering
strengths: Includes built-in layouts for mobile and desktop platforms
Supports customizable themes and custom layouts
Provides dedicated OnscreenKeyboardTextField and OnscreenKeyboardTextFormField widgets
weaknesses: Limited to the layouts and features provided or custom-built using its API
